user.title: Connect to FairGrow
user.description: On {site}, open the Home Assistant section and click **Create pairing code**. Paste the eight characters here. The code works once and lasts fifteen minutes.

data_description.code: For example 7K4M-2QP9. Upper or lower case does not matter.

data_description.url: Only change this if FairGrow told you to.

entities.title: Choose what you share
entities.description: Tick what FairGrow may see and what it may switch. Only what you tick here leaves your Home Assistant. You can change this later with Configure.

data.entities: Sensors, lights and switches to share
data.control: Lights and switches FairGrow may switch

data_description.entities: FairGrow sees the readings of these, and only whether a light or switch is on or off.
data_description.control: Only these can be turned on, off or toggled by an automation on fairgrow.eu. Nothing else in your Home Assistant can be switched, and a command that arrives more than two minutes late is refused. What you tick here is shared as well.
data_description.share_automations: Read only, so that you can take your automations over on fairgrow.eu. FairGrow reads this one file and nothing else; !secret values stay here. Taking over makes a copy there that starts switched off.
data_description.share_scripts: Read only, the same way, for your scripts.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair FairGrow again
reauth_confirm.description: FairGrow no longer accepts this connection, for example because it was disconnected on fairgrow.eu. Create a new pairing code there and paste it here. Your choice of sensors stays.

error.invalid_code: FairGrow does not know this code. Check the eight characters, or create a new code.
error.code_used: This code has already been used. Create a new one.
error.code_expired: This code has expired. Create a new one.
error.bridge_code: This code was made for the FairGrow bridge. Create a new code with the Home Assistant button.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach FairGrow. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant.

init.title: What you share
init.description: Tick what FairGrow may see and what it may switch. What you untick stops; its history on FairGrow stays.
